Commentary.Commentary: It seems a good deck to bat on and with the fire power Afghanistan posses, they will be really confident of chasing it down and clinch the series. Ireland will have to bowl sensationally well to pull something special. Join us for the chase in a short while.

The visitors slipped from 156-2 to 229 all out in no time as Rashid Khan anchored the downfall. The star bowled ender with figures of 10-1-29-4. The pacer Fareed Ahmad got three under his name but went for plenty. All the other bowlers were economical except Shenwari who just bowled one over. All the other batsmen failed to make the most of the start provided by the top order as they all fell cheaply.

Afghanistan have bounced back into the game with some sensational bowling from their talented youngster Rashid Khan. Ireland started off really well and continued till Rashid was introduced into the attack. Joyce was the first man to fall and Stirling soon followed after scoring a fifty. The skipper Porterfield and the veteran batsman Niall O'Brien both started well but hardly capitalised on it. George Dockrell kept on the fight as he scored a vital 21 runs in the fag end of the innings to help them post a total above 220.

IRELAND ARE BOWLED OUT FOR 229! They have failed to play out fifty overs. Short of a length delivery, around leg, Murtagh swivels across looking to pull it towards fine leg. But he edges it towards Shahzad who grabs it quite comfortably. Afghanistan are in a huddle before heading to the pavilion.
Jacob Mulder is the last man in.

OUT! Bowled 'em. Ends his quota with a wicket. Fuller delivery, on the sticks, Dockrell makes room aiming to go over covers but misses. The ball goes crashes on to the middle stump. Dockrell's brief stay comes to an end and Ireland are nine down!
Good length delivery, around off, Murtagh punches it through mid on for a single.
Fuller delivery, around leg, Dockrell pushes it towards covers and runs one.
Tim Murtagh walks out to bat.

OUT! Another one bites the dust. Full delivery outside off, McBrine looks to go over mid off, but only manages a top edge. The ball flies high up in the air and Dawlat Zadran runs in from third man, gets under the ball and cups it. A good catch from Zadran, judged it to perfection.
Short of a length delivery, Dockrell pulls it towards long on for a single.

Length ball around off, Dockrell drives to covers. McBrine thinks there is a single and takes off. Dockrell doesn't and stands in his crease. There is clear lack of communication between both these batsmen.

Afghanistan enquire about a caught behind, the umpire is unmoved. Full and outside off, McBrine looks to run it down but misses as Shahzad collects it. The bowler and the keeper appeal but the umpire turns it down.
Attempts a yorker but it ends up being a low full toss, Dockrell drives it towards covers and takes a single.
Short delivery, around off, McBrine plays the ramp shot towards third man. One run added to the total.
Shortish delivery, outside off, Dockrell slap-pulls it through mid on for a single.
Slower back of a length delivery, McBrine looks to clip it but it takes the inside edge and goes onto hit the pads and falls back on the pitch. The batsmen run through for a single.
Short of a length delivery, coming back in, tucked away through square leg for one run.
Dawlat Zadran is back into the attack.
FOUR! Timed to perfection. Full and around off, McBrine stands tall in his crease and clips it through mid-wicket for a boundary. The long on fielder hared across to stop it but to no avail.
Fuller and on off, McBrine drives it through covers for a single.
Bangs this short, Dockrell looks to pull but misses.
Dockrell and McBrine are building a partnership and will have to unleash as soon as possible as they have only a bit more than four overs left.

NOT OUT! Angles in a fuller length ball, from around the wicket, which nips back in, flicked through mid-wicket for a couple. The deep mid-wicket fielder hurls a throw at non-striker's end and it hits. Afghanistan appeal and the umpire takes it upstairs. Replays show that McBrine had easily made his ground and two runs get added to the total.
FOUR! Short and around leg, Dockrell stays in his crease and pulls it to deep square leg for a boundary. Excellent shot!
Short delivery, around head height, Dockrell defends it with soft hands towards the leg side and looks for a single. But Fareed chases the ball to stop the run.
Dockrell pushes this towards point and runs one. Rashid Khan finishes yet another brilliant spell. His figures - 10-1-29-4.
FOUR! Risky but required! Flighted delivery, outside off, Dockrell drives past the diving cover fielder and the ball rolls away for a boundary. A risky shot but the batsman gets his reward.
Floated delivery, outside off, McBrine flicks it uppishly to deep mid-wicket. Single taken.
Marginally short and outside off, cut through covers. One run added to the total.
Wrong 'un, outside off, Dockrell cuts it towards deep point for a single.
Tossed up delivery, outside off, Dockrell drills it through covers for one run.
Back of a length delivery, around middle, Dockrell plays a half-hearted pull and it goes high up in the air. However, the ball falls short of Stanikzai at deep mid-wicket. Single taken.
On a length and outside off, cuts it through covers for a single.
Full and around leg, Dockrell flicks it through square leg for a single.
Low full toss, outside off, McBrine pushes to mid off and sets off. The mid off fielder has a shy at non striker's end but misses. Had he hit it, it would've been close.
Four leg byes! Sprays this on the pads, McBrine looks to tickle but it hits his pads and goes towards the fine leg fence for a boundary.
On a length, outside off, pushes to the cover region.
Fareed Ahmad is back for a bowl.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Short and sliding down the leg side, Dockrell looks to pull but gets rapped on the pads. Rashid appeals, wonder why, and it is turned down.

Run out chance goes down! Tossed up delivery, outside off, Dockrell pushes it to point and looks for a single. McBrine responds and is halfway down the pitch. Shafiqullah at covers makes a stop and is in two minds as to where to throw it. In the end he throws it at the keeper's end but Dockrell was well in.
George Dockrell walks out to the middle.

OUT! A blinder from Shenwari at short extra cover. Rashid bowls a googly around off, Thomspon looks to push it over covers but doesn't time it properly. The ball lobs towards covers, where Shenwari dives to his left to take a one handed catch. Rashid gets his fourth!
Flatter and quicker, around leg, tucked away through square leg for one run.
Fullish again and on the sticks, McBrine goes ahead and blocks.
Flighted delivery, outside off, Andy drives it through covers for a single.
Quicker and flatter, around off, McBrine defends it.
Fuller again and on middle, Andy prods forward to block.
Short and marginally outside off, McBrine rocks back and cuts it to point.
Full and on the sticks, McBrine goes forward and buries it.
Thompson pushes this tossed up delivery through covers for a single.
Andy McBrine makes his way to the middle.

OUT! Rashid Khan rakes up another wicket to his name! Tossed up delivery in the line of the stumps, Niall prods forward and tries to defend it but he fails to read the straighter one. He gets rapped on the pads and the players appeal. The umpire obliges as he says yes. The danger man Niall is making his way back to the pavilion.
On the pads, Thompson clips it off his pads for a single through the square leg region.
Thompson gets beaten again by the wrong 'un.
Wrong 'un outside off, Thompson fails to defend the ball which is spinning away.
On the pads, Thompson clips it through mid-wicket for a single.
Tossed up around off, the batsman gets a leading edge towards point.
Rashid Khan is back into the attack.
Powerplay 3 has been taken. Five fielders are allowed outside the circle for the final ten overs.
Tossed up outside off, Thompson drives it through covers for a single.
On the pads, Thompson clips it through the square leg region for a single.
Flighted in the line of the stumps, Thompson pushes it back to the bowler.
Full into the stumps, Thompson blocks it well.
Floated outside off, Thompson prods forward and defends it.
Down the leg side, Niall clips it through mid-wicket for a single.
Stuart Thompson is the next man in.

OUT! Cleaned Up! Yorker right on the money this time, Wilson cannot dig it out and the ball rattles the timber. The perfect delivery any bowler in the world will relish. Wilson has to make his way back to the hut.
Short delivery into the pads, Niall gets it off his gloves on the leg side for a single.

NOT OUT! Good length delivery outside off, Wilson pushes it towards the point region and rushes for a single. The field rushes to it and has a shy at the non-striker's end. This time he hits and the umpires go upstairs to check if Wilson has completed the run. Replays show that he was well in time to complete the single.
The umpire has gone upstairs for a run out against Gary Wilson, who seems to be in danger.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
A bit short outside off, Niall O'Brien stays deep in his crease and pushes it through point for a single.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Wilson cuts it through point for a single.
FOUR! Niall gets on the charge! Floated outside off, Niall sit down and gets his slog sweep to the wide delivery and gets it through the square leg region for a boundary.
Leg bye! On the pads, Wilson gets rapped on his pads and the batsmen run a leg bye.
Tossed up outside off, Wilson dances down the track and blocks it.
Niall gets his sweep right this time and manages to get it through the mid-wicket region for a single.
Outside off, Niall shuffles across and sits down to play the sweep. He misses it completely and gets rapped on the pads. The players appeal but it is turned down by the umpire.
Floated outside off, Niall pushes it towards the fielder at point.
Mohammad Nabi is back into the attack.
Full into the stumps, Wilson drives it straight to the fielder at mid off.
Good length delivery into the hips, the ball jumps up from the surface and takes Niall by surprise. He ends up flicking it an unorthodox manner over the mid-wicket region for a single.
Good length delivery outside off, Niall O'Brien goes to have a poke at it but misses it completely.
Niall stays in his crease and defends it with a straight bat.
Niall O'Brien stays in his crease and pushes it towards mid off.
Full delivery into the stumps, Wilson drives it down the ground for a single.
Dawlat Zadran is back into the attack.
Full and outside off, driven away to covers.
Angles in a full length ball, Niall flicks it to mid-wicket.
On a length, outside off, tapped to third man for a single.
Full and in the line of the stumps, Wilson pats it towards the off side.

Another appeal! Similar decision. Naib bowls a similar ball, Wilson plays the same shot. Afghanistan are more confident this time around, but the umpire is unmoved.  Wilson affords a smile after that which suggests that he might have nicked it.

Huge appeal for a caught behind, the umpire is not interested. Naib bowls this very full and outside off, Wilson looks to squeeze it away but misses and the ball goes to Shahzad. There was a noise as the ball went back but probably the bat hit the ground and hence the umpire didn't give it out.
Gulbadin Naib comes back.
Wilson eases this one down the wicket for a single to keep strike.
Played through mid-wicket by the batsman.
Tossed in the line of the stumps, Niall pushes it towards deep point for a single.
Gary Wilson strolls out in the middle.

OUT! Rashid Khan strikes! Just after he goes for the boundary, Rashid tosses up a googly outside off. Balbirnie goes for a slog sweep but fails to make the desired contact. The ball flies off the top edge and the fielder from deep square leg hares across to his left, dives forward and takes a good catch. Balbirnie's short stay in the middle comes to an end.
FOUR! Top shot! Short delivery outside off, Balbirnie gets his broom out this time and sweeps it powerfully through the mid-wicket region for a boundary.
Tossed up outside off, Niall pushes forward to defend but manages to get an inside edge which goes towards square leg for a single.
Length delivery outside off, Niall pushes it towards third man for a single.
WIDE! Way down the leg side, Niall cannot flick it away.
The batsman has played the square drive. They pick up a single.

Fuller delivery way outside off, Andy tries to squeeze it through the point region. He ends up hitting his bat on the deck but the players appeal for a caught behind. But the umpire stays firm and says no. Good umpiring there!

Leg bye! Way down the leg side, Niall O'Brien tries to clip it off his pads but he misses. The ball hits the pads and goes behind the stumps, Shahzad dives to his right but cannot stop it completely as the players run a single.
Down the leg side, Andy flicks it through the mid-wicket region for a single.
Full outside off, Balbirnie drives it straight to the fielder at covers.
On the pads, O'Brien goes to clip it off his pads but fails to make contact as he gets hit on his thigh pad.
The batsman has swept that one through the leg side. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Andy clips it towards the mid-wicket fielder.
WIDE! Down the leg side this time, Andy goes for a sweep but cannot make contact. The umpire signals it as a wide.
Short delivery outside off, the batsman cuts it past point for a single.
Floats a googly around middle and off, Niall gets totally beaten by the wrong 'un as he tries to defend it.
Tossed up outside off, Niall stays deep in his crease and defends it.
Full into the pads, Andy clips it straight to the fielder at mid-wicket.
WIDE! Down the leg side, Balbirnie tries to clip it but misses. The umpire signals it as a wide.
Andy Balbirnie is the next man in.

OUT! Soft dismissal! Good length delivery outside off, Porterfield goes to poke at it but ends up getting an outside edge. The ball flies away to the keeper for a simple regulation catch which Shahzad doesn't miss. Ahmad breaks an important partnership which could have done loads of damage.

FOUR! Good shot! Good length delivery outside off, Porterfield pushes it through the point region. Shahidi the substitue fielder tries to cut it off with a dive but the ball goes over the fence. A boundary there.
FOUR! Easy pickings! Angling down the leg side, Porterfield clips it through for a boundary.
Length delivery outside off, Niall pushes it through covers for a single. The fielder there makes a good stop.
On the pads, Porterfield clips it through the mid-wicket region for a single.
Fareed Ahmad comes back into the attack.

Huge shout for LBW! Floated in the line of the stumps, the ball drifts in after pitching. He fails to make contact and gets rapped on the pads. The players appeal loudly but the umpire denies it. It seemed really close.
Nial O'Brien clips it straight to the fielder at mid-wicket.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the backfoot.
Floated outside off, Niall fails to make contact there as he attempts to defend it.
Sliding on the pads, Niall fails it clip it through the leg side. The players appeal but the umpire stays put. It was surely down the leg side.
William Porterfield completes 3000 ODI runs.
Low full toss outside off, Porterfield drives it down the ground towards long off for a single.
Slower full delivery, around off, Niall defends it towards point.
Angles in a full ball, around off, Niall looks to drive but it goes off the inner half of the bat to the bowler.
Length delivery and around middle, tucks it through square leg for a brace.
Leg bye. Naib, goes round the wicket, and bowls a length delivery around leg as WP looks to clip it away but misses. Naib appeals but the umpire turns it down. Leg bye taken.
Back of a length delivery, Niall tucks it through fine leg for a single.
FOUR! Bowls it on the pads, and Niall tickles it very fine for a boundary. Poor delivery and duly punished by the Irish batsman.
Gulbadin Naib is back on.
Tossed up, outside off, William leaves it alone.
Floats this one around middle as William looks to block, however the ball whizzes past his outside edge.
Shortish and around middle, William rocks back and knocks it back to the bowler.
Porterfield pushes this floated delivery towards the off side.
Wrong 'un in the line of the stumps, WP plays it with soft hands towards point.
Fuller and outside off, WP defends.
Rashid Khan is back for a bowl.
Tosses this on around off, Niall looks to defend but it takes the outside edge and goes towards point.
Niall has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Defended off the front foot towards the off side by O'Brien.

Niall eases this through mid off for one run. The  long off fielder hurls a throw at striker's end and it hits. Resulting to which the ball goes towards third man and they take another run. Two runs added to the total.
WP sweeps this floated delivery through square leg for a run.
Tossed up delivery, outside off, drives it towards covers.
Wide! Strays this down the leg side, WP looks to sweep but misses.
Angles in a full ball, which comes back in, knocks it back to the bowler.
Wide! Sprays this outside leg, Niall looks to flick but misses. Shahzad collects it and the umpire calls it a wide.
Good length delivery, outside off, cut straight to point.
Marginally ahead of length, driven through covers for one run.
Back of a length delivery, Niall gets on his toes and blocks it with soft hands towards covers. One run taken.
Sticks to the full length and keeps it outside off, WP drives through covers for a single.
Fuller and around off, William prods forward and blocks.
Floated delivery, outside off, WP plays it with soft hands on the off side and runs one.
Floats this one on the off, defended towards covers for a single.
Quicker and flatter, bunted back to the bowler.
Fullish and on the sticks, drives it through covers for a couple.
Full and around leg, Niall blocks.
Tosses this one on middle, Porterfield pushes it towards covers for a single.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
FOUR! Brilliant shot. Full and on the sticks, Niall just drives it past the diving mid off fielder for a boundary.
Niall has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Length ball, around off, WP looks to cut but it takes the inside edge and goes towards square leg. Single taken.
Full and outside off, Niall drives it towards covers, who dives to stop but ends up parrying the ball towards mid off. One run taken.
Leg bye! LBW appeal, turned down! Full and around leg, WP looks to flick but misses and gets rapped on the pads. Naib goes up but the umpire is unmoved. Leg bye taken.
Loops this one outside off, Niall defends it well.
Floats this one outside off, Porterfield cuts it over covers for a single.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Tossed up around off, WP offers a front foot defense.
Faster and on the sticks, blocked towards the leg side.
Full and on the sticks, defended back to the bowler.
Niall O'Brien is the next man in.

OUT! Beaten all ends up. The middle stump has gone for a walk! The man in form departs shortly after scoring a fifty. Fuller delivery, slower too, Stirling plays down the wrong line and misses the ball altogether. The ball goes on to knock the stumps and the celebrations begin. Stirling cannot believe what he has done.
Full and on the sticks, Porterfield looks to nudge it away but it takes the inside edge and goes towards fine leg. Single taken.
Marginally ahead of length, in the line of the stumps, eased through mid on for a single.
Back of a length delivery, swinging in, Stirling looks to pull but it goes off the inner half of the bat to mid-wicket.
Full and around off, PS gets on the front foot and defends it towards the off side.
Wide! Loose delivery. Length and down the leg side, Stirling has got nothing to do with it. Wide called.
Full and around leg, Stirling looks to flick but misses and gets rapped on the pads. A mild appeal for LBW has been turned down.
Change of ends for Gulbadin Naib.
13th fifty for Paul Stirling.
Stirling pushes this through covers. One run taken. The man in form brings up his 4th fifty of the series. This just proves how handy he has been in this series for the visiting team.
Shortish again, William pulls it through fine leg. Single taken.
Floats this one outside off, Porterfield prods forward in defense.
Full toss, outside off, whacked through covers for a single.
Tosses this one around off, PS pats it to point and looks for a single, but his partner is not interested.
SIX! Horrendous delivery. Short and around leg, Stirling stoops low and pulls it brilliantly over mid-wicket for a biggie. Deservedly punished.
Samiullah Shenwari is called into the attack.
FOUR! Whacked! Short and wide outside off, Porterfield smashes it over the the mid off fielder for a boundary.
The batsman has played it to the point region.
Porterfield stays in his crease to defend it.
Slow and short down the leg side, Stirling pulls it but straight to the fielder at short fine leg for a single. Missed out on a boundary. 100 up for Ireland.
Wide outside off, Porterfield throws his bat at it and gets it towards third man for a single.
Angling into the stumps from back of a length, William shuffles and defends it back to the bowler.
Angling into the stumps from a length, Stirling prods forward and defends it on the off side.
Again on the pads, Porterfield clips it fine down the leg side for a single.
Shout for LBW! Down the leg side, Porterfield fails to clip it through the leg side. The players appeal but the umpire rightly rules it not out. It was pitched outside leg.
Fuller delivery outside off, Stirling drives it towards wide mid off for a quick single.
Slower one way outside off, Porterfield pushes it through covers for a single.
Length delivery in the line of the stumps, Porterfield defends it with the full face of the bat.
Gulbadin Naib comes back into the attack.
Angling into the pads, Porterfield clips it through the mid-wicket region for a single.
Slower delivery in the line of the stumps, the ball stays low. William stays in his crease and defends it back to the bowler.
Length delivery outside off, Stirling punches it through covers for a single.
Full outside off, Stirling drives it through the cover region. The sweeper fielder cuts it off and the batsmen run two in the process.
WIDE! Full and wide outside off, Stirling lets it through to the keeper. It was way too wide for him. The umpire signals it as a wide.
Good length delivery outside off, Porterfield pushes it through covers for a single.
FOUR! Good shot! Back of a length delivery outside off, Porterfield comes early into the position and pulls it through the mid-wicket region for a boundary. There was no stopping that.
Fareed Ahmad is back on.
Floated outside off, Porterfield eases it down to long on for a single.
On the pads, Porterfield clips it on the leg side.
Stirling clips it through the mid-wicket region for a single.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket.
Shout for LBW! Tossed up outside off, Stirling shuffles across to defend but gets rapped on the pads. A loud appeal is denied by the umpire as the impact was outside off.
Down the leg side, Stirling goes for the sweep again but cannot beat the fielder at short fine leg.
Porterfield lunges forward in defence.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Floated outside off, Stirling camps back and defends it towards covers for a quick single.
On the pads, Porterfield clips it through the mid-wicket region for a single.
Floated in the line of the stumps, Porterfield stays in his crease to defend it.
Tossed up outside off, Stirling pushes it through covers for a single.
On the legs, WP clips it towards mid-wicket.
Narrow escape! A bit quicker through the air around off, Porterfield tries to defend it. The ball catches the bottom edge and goes one bounce to the keeper. Just misses the stump by a whisker.
Floated around off, Porterfield prods forward in defence but fails to defend it as the ball spins away.
Stirling sweeps it through the square leg region for a single.
SIX! Brilliant! Again a similar delivery but Stirling improvises a bit more this time as he slams this ball out of the park with the same shot.
FOUR! Predetermined! Tossed up outside off, Stirling shuffles and sweeps it over the short fine leg fielder for a boundary.
Floated in the line of the stumps, Porterfield prods forward and defends it.
William Porterfield, the skipper, strolls out in the middle.
Drinks have been called.

OUT! Gone through the gate! Tossed up around middle and leg, the ball drifts in. Joyce is really late to get his bat down as the ball sneaks in between his bat and the pads to rattle the stumps. Joyce has to walk back to the hut as Rashid Khan draws first blood in the encounter.
Tossed up around middle and leg, Joyce prods forward in defence.
Stirling drives it towards long off for a single.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket.
Joyce stays in his crease and pushes it through point for a single.
Full in the line of the stumps, Joyce drives it towards long on for a single.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot.

NOT OUT! Floated outside off, Joyce stays in his crease and pushes it towards covers and looks for a single. The fielder from extra cover dives to his left to make a fine stop. He has a shy at the stumps and Shahzad gathers the ball well to flip off the bails. Joyce traces back to get back in time and it seems close. The umpire goes upstairs to check for it. Replays show that Shahzad had dislodged the bails with his gloves before collecting the ball. So Joyce is safe.
The umpire has gone upstairs for a run out against Paul Stirling. Seems very close.
Full around off this time, Joyce drives it straight to the bowler.
Down the leg side, Joyce clips it towards mid-wicket.
Floated outside off, Joyce prods forward in defence but fails to make contact.
Wrong 'un outside off, Stirling lunges to reach the ball and defends it.
Another one outside off, Stirling leans forward and defends it.
Tossed up around off, Stirling stays in his crease and defends it.
Short delivery in the line of the stumps, Joyce pulls it away through the mid-wicket region for a single.
On the legs, Joyce clips it towards the fielder at mid-wicket.
Starts off with a delivery around off, the ball keeps its line and goes to the keeper. Joyce cannot defend it.
Rashid Khan introduced into the attack. Spin from both ends.
Tossed up around off, Joyce cuts it past the point fielder for a single.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
FOUR! Top shot! Tossed up outside off, Joyce camps back and slashes it through the point region for a boundary.
Joyce prods forward in defence.
SIX! Joyce takes the charge! Tossed in the line of the stumps, Joyce charges down the track and smashes it over the long on region for a biggie.
Around middle and leg, Joyce stays in his crease and defends it.
Mohammad Nabi comes into the attack.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
On a length and on the sticks, Joyce flicks it through mid-wicket for one run.
Joyce gets behind the line of this delivery and blocks it.
On a length, outside off, Stirling looks to push it after getting on the front foot but it takes the outside edge and rolls towards third man. Single taken.
Full and on off, Stirling punches it unconvincingly towards the off side.
FOUR! Width on offer and duly punished. Full and way outside off, Stirling frees his arms and drives it through covers for a boundary.
Powerplay 2 comes in play. Only four fielders are allowed outside the thirty yard circle.
FOUR! Outstanding stroke that! Full and on off, Joyce gets low and drives it effortlessly through covers for a boundary. No need to chase that. 10 off the over.
Full and on the sticks, Joyce drives it to mid off.
Fuller delivery, outside off, pushed towards covers.
FOUR! Length ball and around leg, all Joyce had to do was tickle it away and he does. He plays it very late and off it goes to the fine leg fence for a boundary.
On a length, and on the sticks, Stirling shuffles across and nudges it with soft hands towards mid-wicket. Single taken.

Run out missed! Marginally ahead of a length, outside off, Joyce cuts it to covers and sets off. Shafiqullah, at covers, hurls a throw at the bowler's end but misses. Had he hit it, Joyce would've been a goner.
FOUR! Timed perfectly! Full and swinging in, Stirling moves a touch and flicks it gloriously through mid-wicket for a boundary. The mid on fielder gives it a chase but to no avail.
On a length, outside off, PS whacks it towards covers who makes a tumbling stop.
Good length delivery, outside off, tapped to point.
FOUR! Finally, the visitors have managed to find the gap. Half volley, outside off, Stirling stands in his crease and creams it through covers for a boundary.
Afghanistan go up for a caught behind, the umpire is not interested. On a length, bounces a bit more as Stirling looks to cut but it whizzes past the outside edge and MS collects it.
Full and angling away, Stirling kneels and drives it straight to the cover-point fielder.
Fullish and around off, Stirling defends it with an angled bat towards the bowler.
Very full and on the sticks, PS knocks it down the ground and takes one. Good rotation of strike.
Fullish delivery, on the sticks, Stirling gets across and clips it through fine leg for another couple.
Fuller ball, angling in, Stirling shuffles across and nudges it through mid-wicket for a brace.
Full and around off, Joyce drives it towards mid off and sets off for a run immediately.
On a length, way outside off, Joyce whacks it towards covers and finds the fielder. Ireland are failing to pierce the gaps here.
Full delivery, outside off, Stirling drives... to the cover fielder. Three shots which could've yielded him runs, but ended up going to the fielders.
Good length delivery, in the line of the sticks, Stirling blocks it with a straight face of the bat.
Full and on the sticks, Stirling punches it beautifully, again to the cover fielder!
Full and swinging away, Paul unleashes a cracking cover drive, straight to the point fielder though.
Fuller delivery, fourth stump line, Stirling offers a front foot defense.
Back of a length ball, around off, Joyce whips it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Gulbadin Naib is introduced into the attack.
Slower full delivery, on the stumps, Joyce pushes it towards mid off and steals a quick single.
Good length delivery, Joyce leans forward and defends it towards the off side.
FOUR! How brilliant is that from Joyce? Very full and around off, Joyce looks to keep it out with a dig, a dig that ended up being so good that it went through covers for a boundary.
Fullish delivery, fifth stump line, Joyce shoulders his arms.
Fuller delivery, outside off, Joyce looks to drive it with no foot movement. The ball takes the inside edge and goes onto hit the pads.
Back of a length delivery, Stirling looks to tuck it away but it hits the thigh pad. Leg bye taken.
Wide outside off, Stirling throws his bat at it and gets the last ball of the over towards the third man region for a single to keep strike.
Stirling drives this delivery straight to the fielder at point.
Length delivery angling into the pads, Joyce defends it with soft hands towards the wide mid on region for a quick single.
Full into the pads this pads, Ed Joyce clips it through the mid-wicket region for a couple.
Good length delivery angling across, Stirling leans towards it and drives it off his outer half through the point region for a single.
Full and outside off, the batsmen stays in his crease and pushes it towards the fielder at point.
Fuller in length and around off, Joyce blocks it.
On a length, around off, defended off the front foot.
Length ball, outside off, pats it towards the off side.
Full delivery, around leg, Joyce drives it towards the mid on region.

DROPPED! Reprive for Stirling! Length ball, which comes back, Paul looks to leave it alone but it takes the outside edge of the bat and lobs towards Rashid Khan at first slip dives to his left who fails to catch it. Single taken!
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot.
On a length, around off, driven towards mid off.
Length ball, around off, pushed towards covers.

FOUR! Consecutive boundaries! Poor bowling from Fareed, really. Full again and on the sticks, this time Ed clips it more fine and beats the square leg fielder on the left. The ball races away for a boundary.
FOUR! First runs off the bat. Beautiful shot! Fuller delivery, around off, Joyce flicks it, using his wrists, through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Fullish delivery, nips away, Ed shoulders his arms.
Marginally ahead of a length, outside off, Joyce has nothing to do with it.
Fuller and on the sticks, Stirling brings his bat down in time and knocks it back to the bowler.
Zadran manages to extract extra bounce here after pitching it on a length, Stirling punches it on the bounce towards covers.
Back of a length delivery, outside off, left alone.
Good length delivery, goes away, Stirling leaves it alone.
Short of a length delivery, in the line of the stumps, nips away after pitching and misses Stirling's outside edge. Peach of a delivery.
Length delivery, swings away, good shape there, Stirling watchfully leaves it alone.
Dawlat Zadran will bowl with the second new ball from the other end.
Full delivery, nips away, Joyce has let it through to the keeper.
Wide! Bowls this down the leg side again, bowl that one again the umpire says!
Length ball, which goes away, Joyce shoulders his arms.
Huge LBW appeal, turned down. Angles a length ball, which nips back in, Joyce misses his clip and gets rapped on the pads. Afghanistan go up but the umpire is unmoved. It was going down.
Sticks to the full length, outside off, left alone.
Fullish delivery, swings away, Joyce allows Shahzad to do his job.
Wide! Bowls another delivery down the leg side, Joyce has nothing to do with it. He will have to bowl that again.
Fuller delivery, outside off, Joyce leaves it alone.
Wide! Starts the match with a length ball down the leg side, Joyce looks to flick but it is out of his reach. Wide signalled.

The players are out in the field. Afghanistan players are in a huddle for some prep talk from captain Stanikzai. Paul Stirling and Ed Joyce are at the centre too. Fareed Ahmad will start the proceedings for Afghanistan.

Asghar Stanikzai credits Kevin O'Brien for his fantastic performance in the last game. Adds that they have been in a similar position like this before. Says that they will want to play good cricket and come up on top. Opines that they would look to restrict the opposition somewhere around 250-260. They have the line-up to chase it down. Reveals three changes - Ghani, Hamza and Shahidi make way for Shenwari, Fareed Ahmed, and Tarakai.

William Porterfield says that they are looking to post a good total first and it seems to be a decent pitch for batting. Admits that it was special from Kevin O'Brien to have a niggle and still come back to win them the fourth ODI and it is unfortunate that he misses out today. States that the last two games were must-win matches for them and winning them has given them momentum. Ends by saying that Kevin is not fit and Niall will replace him.
Toss - Finally, Ireland win the toss for the first time in this ODI series, THEY ELECT TO BAT FIRST.

Pitch Report - Chetan Sharma doing the pitch report reckons that the wicket is far better, than the one in previous games. Opines that the team winning the toss should elect to bat first. Adds that it is a very good batting wicket.

Hello and a warm welcome for the final ODI between Afghanistan and Ireland. It has all come till the last game to decide which team gets its hands on the silverware. With Ireland carrying the momentum with two consecutive wins, they will want to make it three in a row and seal the deal. Afghanistan, on the other hand, will have to bounce back and put in a good show to defeat the Irishmen. Stay tuned for the toss and team updates.
